zh:noLimits.v1.engineAsks.text: {engine}使用自己的工具和设置。在无限制级别，Murage 仅在收到的请求可能清空全部数据或造成灾难性破坏时显示权限卡片。已保存的权限规则不会阻止操作。你完全关闭的功能会保持关闭，直到你重新开启。
zh:noLimits.v1.engineAsks.en: {engine} uses its own tools and settings. At No limits, Murage adds no permission cards except for a likely wipe or catastrophe in requests it receives. Saved permission rules do not block actions. Features you switched off entirely stay off until you turn them on.
zh:noLimits.v1.engineAsks.note: Chinese: Native engine owns its tools/settings. Murage adds only wipe/catastrophe cards on received requests; saved rules do not block, entirely off features stay off. Engine placeholder retained. Read against supplied English; core permission/capability distinction and placeholders retained.

zh:permissionMenu.ownTools.text: {engine}使用自己的工具。在询问级别，它只读取和回答。在其他级别，你的{engine}设置仍然有效。在无限制级别，Murage 仅在收到的请求可能清空全部数据或造成灾难性破坏时询问。已保存的权限规则不会阻止操作。你完全关闭的功能会保持关闭，直到你重新开启。
zh:permissionMenu.ownTools.en: {engine} uses its own tools. At Ask, it only reads and answers. At other levels, your {engine} settings still apply. At No limits, Murage asks only about a likely wipe or catastrophe in requests it receives. Saved permission rules do not block actions. Features you switched off entirely stay off until you turn them on.
zh:permissionMenu.ownTools.note: Chinese: Engine tools/settings caveat remains qualified. Ask reading/answering behavior distinguished from other levels; No limits has only wipe/catastrophe questions on received requests, saved-rule bypass and entirely off features remain off. Read against supplied English; core permission/capability distinction and placeholders retained.

zh:ux.l1.level.unlimitedDetail.text: 你的机器人运行命令和工具时不会询问，即使涉及外部内容或 Murage 无法读取的命令也会运行。这可能更改受保护的文件，也可能读取或发送密钥和密码。只有可能清空全部数据或造成灾难性破坏时，才会先询问。已保存的权限规则不会阻止操作。你完全关闭的功能会保持关闭，直到你重新开启。Murage 不会显示卡片，只会说明哪个功能已关闭以及在哪里开启。频道消息关闭后仍保持关闭。其他应用的触发链接和例行任务使用机器人的权限级别。其他人的聊天保持在询问级别，除非你明确设置了该机器人的权限级别。1.0.18 的完全访问设置不算明确设置。
zh:ux.l1.level.unlimitedDetail.en: Your bots run commands and tools without asking, even with outside content or commands Murage cannot read. This can change protected files and read or send keys and passwords. Only a likely wipe or catastrophe asks first. Saved permission rules do not block actions. Features you switched off entirely stay off until you turn them on. Murage says what is off and where to turn it on, without a card. Channel messages off stays off. Trigger links from other apps and routines use the bot's level. Other people's chats stay at Ask unless you explicitly set that bot's level. A setting carried over from 1.0.18 does not count.
zh:ux.l1.level.unlimitedDetail.note: Chinese: Owner tools run, including outside/unreadable content; only likely wipe/catastrophe asks. Saved permissions cannot block. Capability-off behavior, channel-off, bot-level triggers/routines, guest Ask with explicit-bot exception and legacy exclusion are clear. Read against supplied English; core permission/capability distinction and placeholders retained.

zh:ux.l1.level.underTable.text: 在无限制级别，受保护的文件也可以更改，只有可能清空全部数据或造成灾难性破坏时才会先询问。其他应用的触发链接和例行任务使用机器人的权限级别。其他人的聊天保持在询问级别，除非你明确设置了该机器人的权限级别。已保存的权限规则不会阻止操作。你完全关闭的功能会保持关闭，直到你重新开启。
zh:ux.l1.level.underTable.en: At No limits, protected files can change and only a likely wipe or catastrophe asks first. Trigger links from other apps and routines use the bot's level. Other people's chats stay at Ask unless you explicitly set that bot's level. Saved permission rules do not block actions. Features you switched off entirely, including channel messages, stay off until you turn them on.
zh:ux.l1.level.underTable.note: Chinese: Short summary preserves protected-file changes, wipe-only questioning, bot-level triggers/routines, guest Ask with explicit-bot exception, permission-rule bypass and wholly disabled capabilities remaining off. Read against supplied English; core permission/capability distinction and placeholders retained.

zh:ux.l1.confirm.unlimitedBody.en: {level} lets {bot} run commands and tools without asking. Outside content and commands Murage cannot read also run. This can change protected files and read or send keys and passwords. Only a likely wipe or catastrophe asks first. Saved permission rules do not block actions. Features you switched off entirely stay off until you turn them on. Murage says what is off and where to turn it on, without a card. Channel messages off stays off. Trigger links from other apps and routines use the bot's level. Other people's chats stay at Ask unless you explicitly set that bot's level. A setting carried over from 1.0.18 does not count.
zh:ux.l1.confirm.unlimitedBody.note: Chinese: Confirmation preserves both placeholders and clearly states command/tool execution, outside/unreadable content, key/password exposure, wipe-only questions, permission-rule bypass, off-feature explanation, trigger/routine level, guest exception and legacy exclusion. Read against supplied English; core permission/capability distinction and placeholders retained.

zh:ux.lcopyb.level.unlimitedHere.text: 你的机器人运行命令和工具时不会询问，即使涉及外部内容或 Murage 无法读取的命令也会运行。这可能更改受保护的文件，也可能读取或发送密钥和密码。只有可能清空全部数据或造成灾难性破坏时，才会先询问。已保存的权限规则不会阻止操作。你完全关闭的功能会保持关闭，直到你重新开启。Murage 不会显示卡片，只会说明哪个功能已关闭以及在哪里开启。频道消息关闭后仍保持关闭。其他应用的触发链接和例行任务使用机器人的权限级别。其他人的聊天保持在询问级别，除非你明确设置了该机器人的权限级别。1.0.18 的完全访问设置不算明确设置。这包括在这台电脑上点击和输入。
zh:ux.lcopyb.level.unlimitedHere.en: Your bots run commands and tools without asking, even with outside content or commands Murage cannot read. This can change protected files and read or send keys and passwords. Only a likely wipe or catastrophe asks first. Saved permission rules do not block actions. Features you switched off entirely stay off until you turn them on. Murage says what is off and where to turn it on, without a card. Channel messages off stays off. Trigger links from other apps and routines use the bot's level. Other people's chats stay at Ask unless you explicitly set that bot's level. A setting carried over from 1.0.18 does not count. This includes clicking and typing on this computer.
zh:ux.lcopyb.level.unlimitedHere.note: Chinese: Owner/computer variant preserves full No limits behavior and explicitly includes local clicking/typing; no extra browser, email, publishing or unreadable-command approval promised. Read against supplied English; core permission/capability distinction and placeholders retained.

zh:ux.lcopyb.level.unlimited.text: 你的机器人运行命令和工具时不会询问，即使涉及外部内容或 Murage 无法读取的命令也会运行。这可能更改受保护的文件，也可能读取或发送密钥和密码。只有可能清空全部数据或造成灾难性破坏时，才会先询问。已保存的权限规则不会阻止操作。你完全关闭的功能会保持关闭，直到你重新开启。Murage 不会显示卡片，只会说明哪个功能已关闭以及在哪里开启。频道消息关闭后仍保持关闭。其他应用的触发链接和例行任务使用机器人的权限级别。其他人的聊天保持在询问级别，除非你明确设置了该机器人的权限级别。1.0.18 的完全访问设置不算明确设置。
zh:ux.lcopyb.level.unlimited.en: Your bots run commands and tools without asking, even with outside content or commands Murage cannot read. This can change protected files and read or send keys and passwords. Only a likely wipe or catastrophe asks first. Saved permission rules do not block actions. Features you switched off entirely stay off until you turn them on. Murage says what is off and where to turn it on, without a card. Channel messages off stays off. Trigger links from other apps and routines use the bot's level. Other people's chats stay at Ask unless you explicitly set that bot's level. A setting carried over from 1.0.18 does not count.
zh:ux.lcopyb.level.unlimited.note: Chinese: Owner tools run with wipe-only questioning; stored rules never block; entirely off capabilities stay off with explanation; channel-off and non-owner/explicit-bot/legacy distinctions are retained. Read against supplied English; core permission/capability distinction and placeholders retained.

zh:ux.lcopyb.level.channelHint.text: 默认开启，除非你将它关闭。在无限制级别，你自己的频道消息无需询问就会执行。其他人的聊天保持在询问级别，除非你明确设置了该机器人的权限级别。其他应用的触发链接和例行任务使用机器人的权限级别。
zh:ux.lcopyb.level.channelHint.en: On unless you turn it off. At No limits, your own channel messages run without asking. Other people's chats stay at Ask unless you explicitly set that bot's level. Trigger links from other apps and routines use the bot's level.
zh:ux.lcopyb.level.channelHint.note: Chinese: Channel switch remains an actual off switch. Enabled owner messages run at No limits. Guests remain Ask unless bot explicitly set; triggers/routines use bot level. Read against supplied English; core permission/capability distinction and placeholders retained.

zh:ux.lcopyb.level.peerSkip.text: 已开启，但{level}在你自己的聊天和该级别的例行任务中会跳过此询问。在完全访问级别，其他应用的触发链接 仍会询问。在无限制级别，其他应用的触发链接和例行任务使用机器人的权限级别。切换到自动级别，即可每次都先询问。
zh:ux.lcopyb.level.peerSkip.en: On, but {level} skips this in your own chats and in routines at that level. Trigger links from other apps still ask at Full access. At No limits, trigger links from other apps and routines use the bot's level. Switch to Auto to be asked each time.
zh:ux.lcopyb.level.peerSkip.note: Chinese: Full access trigger-link questioning is expressly limited to that lower level. No limits triggers/routines use bot level. Auto instruction remains a lower-level choice. Read against supplied English; core permission/capability distinction and placeholders retained.

zh:highlevel.canChangeHelp.text: 你先在这台电脑上批准每项更改。在无限制级别，更改无需询问就会执行，可能清空全部数据或造成灾难性破坏的情况除外。已保存的权限规则不会阻止操作。你完全关闭的功能会保持关闭，直到你重新开启。
zh:highlevel.canChangeHelp.en: You approve each change on this computer first. At No limits, changes run without asking, except for a likely wipe or catastrophe. Saved permission rules do not block actions. Features you switched off entirely stay off until you turn them on.
zh:highlevel.canChangeHelp.note: Chinese: Default per-change approval is explicitly followed by the No limits exception; only likely wipe/catastrophe questions remain. Saved-rule bypass and off-feature exception are clear. Read against supplied English; core permission/capability distinction and placeholders retained.

zh:highlevel.fullHelp.text: 完全控制还允许删除、发布、发送文档、发票和付款，以及更改用户和套餐。无限制：只有可能清空全部数据或造成灾难性破坏时，才会先询问。已保存的权限规则不会阻止操作。你完全关闭的功能会保持关闭，直到你重新开启。其他应用的触发链接和例行任务使用机器人的权限级别。
zh:highlevel.fullHelp.en: Full control also allows deleting, publishing, sending documents, invoices and payments, and changing users and plans. At No limits, only a likely wipe or catastrophe asks first. Saved permission rules do not block actions. Features you switched off entirely stay off until you turn them on. Trigger links from other apps and routines use the bot's level.
zh:highlevel.fullHelp.note: Chinese: Concrete deletion/publishing/documents/invoices/payments/user/plan examples do not add approval gates. No limits has wipe-only questioning, saved-rule bypass, entirely off features and bot-level triggers/routines. Read against supplied English; core permission/capability distinction and placeholders retained.

zh:noLimits.followers.counts.en: {bots} bots and {routines} routines follow No limits
zh:noLimits.followers.counts.note: Chinese: Count placeholders retained; describes participating bots/routines rather than guest-chat inheritance. Read against supplied English; core permission/capability distinction and placeholders retained.

zh:noLimits.followers.upgradeBody.text: 你设置为较低权限的机器人和聊天会保留原级别。例行任务使用其机器人的级别。你可以保留这些机器人和聊天的设置，也可以使用无限制。
zh:noLimits.followers.upgradeBody.en: Bots and chats you set lower keep their levels. Routines use their bot's level. You can keep those bot and chat choices or use No limits.
zh:noLimits.followers.upgradeBody.note: Chinese: User-set lower bot/chat choices are preserved; routines use their bot level. Choice to keep levels or use No limits is clear. Read against supplied English; core permission/capability distinction and placeholders retained.
